method: Native-touch mobile engineering. Isolated platform20m above the station, player/enemy/cover poses, suppressed AI and synchronous component/shutter states are arranged. Actual rifle input, ammo/damage, camera, visibility and UI/storage tested. Arranged victory tests scoring only; no played mission or human enjoyment proof.

checks: near miss selects an actual visible body surface within5 degrees
phase, device, weapon, option and angle/range exclusions
existing direct hits are preserved
a manually aimed optic keeps its normal precision hit
foreign cover blocks both corrected and original centre paths
a foreground actor cannot be bypassed to assist a rear actor
real native near-miss fire consumes ammunition and damage without steering the camera
disabling assistance leaves the same native near miss uncorrected
pause clears assisted reticle state
component assistance requires a live, exposed, visible winding
assisted scores use separate storage even after the option is disabled
native assistance preference survives apply and reload
